title: SS27 Girls' Colour Stories
summary: Girls' colour stories: Pearl and Tides, Meadow, and Pop.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Piccoli Principi's "Pearl & Tides" swimwear runs from vintage pink to pastel green and soft navy, in technical fabrics including sustainable lycra, with UV protection<sup>[1]</sup>
- Fatamadrina lists oversized florals, checks with fruit prints, paisley, vintage geometrics, nautical themes and gingham, and "Wildflowers Bloom" with delicate handcrafted embroidery<sup>[2]</sup>
- Poco Blush, designed "almost exclusively for girls", showed bold hues and a loose, printed, reversible dress, and a T-shirt that releases a minty scent when crumpled<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Pearl and Tides
sections.body: Vintage pink, pastel green and soft navy for swim and beach.

sections.heading: Meadow
sections.body: Lavender, pastel green and white for dresses.

sections.heading: Pop
sections.body: Lemon, coral, aqua and red for play.

design_implications:
- One capsule per story.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Meadow and Pearl and Tides carry volume.
